services.name: Art + Wellness: Yoga
services.desc: Do you need to shed some stress after work? Yoga is the perfect solution, and it’s back at the Utah Museum of Fine Arts this fall! Wait out the rush-hour traffic and decompress at the Museum before heading home. Experience Onishi Yasuaki’s monumental installation Stone on Boundary in a whole new way! Join YogaSix Sugarhouse in the UMFA Great Hall Wednesdays, September 2 through October 14, to learn the art of yoga and explore the unique connections between yoga practice and themes in the UMFA galleries. All levels of experience and ability are welcome! There will be six sessions in all, and guests are welcome to attend as many as they would like.RSVP is encouraged for this free event.
